# Product synchronization

This is the synchronization entry point for **Mole CLI (macOS)**, branch `main` of `tw93/Mole`. Workflow and the four canonical product names are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#product-synchronization). Source review baseline: `3fdf4040`, with incremental review through `c5ca9f69` on 2026-10-15, Asia/Singapore. This is a source/record review, not a new full runtime audit or a release.

## Ownership

- The two CLIs: the [Windows branch SYNC.md](https://github.com/tw93/Mole/blob/windows/SYNC.md) owns the shared CLI adaptation queue; the macOS entry links to it rather than duplicating rows.
- Mole CLI (macOS) with Mole Mac: the app's root `SYNC.md` owns the detailed comparison.
- Mole CLI (Windows) with Mole for Windows, and the two apps: Mole for Windows' root `SYNC.md` owns the detailed comparison.
- App-owned records remain private. Public CLI records contain public behavior, source and tests only; never copy private catalogs, implementation details, support data or repository links here.

Scoped follow-up on 2026-10-18: Mole CLI (macOS) `8f2671cd` adapts the scan-request lifecycle from Mole CLI (Windows) `b8b27771`, including macOS cache-return paths. The existing CLI-SYNC-04 entry in the Windows record owns this comparison. Local tests passed and source is pushed; [the audit record](docs/weekly-audit.md#2026-10-18-dual-cli-post-release-audit) separates source delivery from exact-head CI. This is not a new release or a review of the desktop apps.

## 2026-10-23 System-service signal identity

Implemented (source, unreleased): `lib/optimize/tasks.sh` refreshes NotificationCenter through its current-user launchd service and mDNSResponder through the allowlisted label in its fixed system plist. Neither operation falls back to matching a process name. The two-CLI queue remains owned by the Windows branch record; its Optimize has no corresponding host restart. The private app-owned record tracks the app comparison separately. Old-source refusal/target tests fail as expected, all 141 targeted Optimize tests and the complete local check/test workflows pass. These are source and test results, not a new package or a live system-service restart.

| Wallpaper render cache | Released (V1.60.0) | `Wallpaper agent cache` in `lib/clean/user.sh` now takes only exact `<sha256>-<w>-<h>-<n>-<hex>.bmp` renders older than a week that are not a render of the newest picture of each display size or the newest overall, the same rule as Mole Mac; the rest of the agent container stays. Each run takes at most the 50 oldest renders under its own handle-probe budget, so a large backlog drains over several runs without starving the other container rows, and a folder with more than 20000 renders offers nothing.
